name: Magnesium Glycinate 200 mg
tagline: 200 mg elemental magnesium in the gentler glycinate form.
description: A single-ingredient magnesium formula with vitamin B6 in its active form. No proprietary blends, no fillers — every number is printed on the label.

benefits.title: Muscle and nerve support
benefits.text: Magnesium supports normal muscle function and normal nerve transmission.

benefits.title: Energy metabolism
benefits.text: Supports the processes that turn food into usable energy.

benefits.title: Gentle on the stomach
benefits.text: The glycinate form is chelated, which many people tolerate better than oxide.

ingredients.name: Magnesium
ingredients.why: Supports normal muscle and nerve function

use: Take one capsule daily with food, or as directed by your healthcare professional. Do not exceed the stated dose.
storage: Store below 30°C in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.
allergens: No known allergens. Free from added sugar, gluten and artificial colours.

faq.q: Can I take magnesium at night?
faq.a: Yes. Many people prefer it in the evening because it supports normal muscle relaxation. Take it with food to reduce the chance of loose stools, and keep to the stated dose.
Glycinate is a chelated form, which is generally gentler on the digestive system. Oxide is cheaper but has lower absorption and is more likely to cause loose stools at higher doses.

faq.q: Is this safe with other medication?
faq.a: Check with your doctor or pharmacist first. Magnesium can affect how certain antibiotics and thyroid medicines are absorbed, so timing may need to be adjusted.

name: Probiotic 10B CFU
tagline: Ten billion CFU across six documented strains.
description: A six-strain probiotic with 10 billion CFU per capsule and a small prebiotic base. Strain names and counts are printed, not hidden behind a blend.

benefits.title: Digestive comfort
benefits.text: Supports normal digestion and day-to-day gut comfort.

benefits.title: Gut flora balance
benefits.text: Supports a balanced mix of bacteria in the gut.

benefits.title: Shelf-stable strains
benefits.text: Selected for stability at room temperature when stored as directed.

ingredients.name: Inulin
ingredients.why: Prebiotic fibre that feeds gut bacteria

use: Take one capsule daily with water, preferably before a meal. Refrigeration is not required, but keep the bottle closed and dry.
storage: Store below 25°C in a dry place. Avoid humidity and direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.
allergens: Contains no dairy, gluten or soy. Do not use if the seal is broken.

faq.q: Do I need to refrigerate it?
faq.a: No. The strains were selected for room-temperature stability, but keep the bottle closed and away from humidity. If your home gets very hot, a cool cupboard is better than a kitchen counter.

faq.q: When will I notice a difference?
faq.a: Digestion varies from person to person. Give it a few weeks of consistent use, and speak to your doctor if symptoms persist or worsen.

faq.q: Can I take it with antibiotics?
faq.a: Ask your doctor. Many people space probiotics a few hours away from antibiotic doses, but the timing should be confirmed by your clinician.

name: Vitamin D3 + K2
tagline: 2000 IU D3 with 100 mcg K2 as MK-7.
description: A daily D3 and K2 pair for people who spend most of the day indoors. Both doses are printed on the front of the label.

benefits.title: Immune function
benefits.text: Vitamin D supports normal immune system function.

benefits.title: Bone health
benefits.text: Supports normal bone maintenance alongside calcium.

benefits.title: Calcium absorption
benefits.text: Vitamin K2 supports normal calcium metabolism.

ingredients.name: Vitamin D3
ingredients.why: Supports normal immune function and bone health

use: Take one tablet daily with a meal that contains fat, or as directed by your healthcare professional.
storage: Store below 30°C in a cool, dry place. Keep the bottle tightly closed.
allergens: Contains no gluten, dairy or added sugar. Check with your doctor if you take blood thinners.

faq.a: Vitamin D supports calcium absorption, and vitamin K2 supports normal calcium metabolism. Pairing them is common in daily formulas aimed at bone and immune support.

faq.q: Do I need a blood test first?
faq.a: It is worth asking your doctor. Vitamin D status is easy to test, and the right dose depends on your current level rather than a guess.

faq.q: Can I take it with calcium?
faq.a: Many people do, but confirm the total daily amount with your clinician so you stay within safe limits.

name: Biotin 10,000 mcg
tagline: A single high-strength biotin tablet, nothing else added.
description: One ingredient, one dose, one tablet a day. Biotin supports normal hair and skin maintenance as part of a balanced diet.

benefits.title: Hair and skin support
benefits.text: Biotin supports normal hair and skin maintenance.

benefits.title: No fillers
benefits.text: No added sugar, no artificial colours, no unnecessary excipients.

ingredients.name: Biotin
ingredients.why: Supports normal hair and skin maintenance

use: Take one tablet daily with food. Do not exceed the stated dose.
storage: Store below 30°C in a cool, dry place, away from moisture.
allergens: Free from gluten, dairy and soy. Suitable for adults 18+.

faq.a: Hair grows slowly, so give it at least two to three months of consistent use. Results vary, and a balanced diet matters more than any single supplement.
Yes. High-dose biotin can interfere with some thyroid and hormone tests. Tell your doctor that you take it, and stop a few days before a blood test if advised.

faq.q: Can I take it with a multivitamin?
faq.a: Check the total biotin across products to avoid doubling up. If you already take a multivitamin, compare labels before adding this.
